WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    t.telescregistry,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) as avg_modindex,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshift
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as baseline_modindex
  FROM group_stats
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.weathprofile,
    gs.avg_modindex,
    gs.avg_phaseshift,
    b.baseline_modindex
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE gs.avg_modindex > b.baseline_modindex
)
SELECT 
  fg.weathprofile,
  AVG(fg.avg_modindex) as avg_modindex,
  AVG(fg.avg_phaseshift) as avg_phaseshift,
  AVG(fg.avg_modindex - fg.baseline_modindex) as avg_above_baseline
FROM filtered_groups fg
GROUP BY fg.weathprofile
